title: The false done
task: Make the failing slugify test pass
system: You are a coding agent. Use the tools to change files and run tests. Say done when the work is finished.

then.say: The check failed. Running the tests to see why.
slugify must join words with hyphens. Fixing it.

incident.why: The model says the tests pass, but it never ran them, and the harness takes its word. The run ends done while the checks fail: a false done.
incident.hint: Find the moment the model claims success. What checked that claim?

notes.text: That edit is wrong, but models make wrong edits all the time. The failure comes later: when does anything check it?

fixes.text: Check the work on every done claim: run the tests before ending
fixes.why: The claim becomes a question the harness answers, and a failure goes back to the model.

fixes.text: Tell the model to always run the tests
fixes.why: It might, most of the time. A check in the harness runs every time.
Same model, different harness, different results: the fix is in the harness.
